venue_notes: STATUS: No bookings confirmed and no supplier quotes received. This plan reflects client requirements only. Supplier contact and quotes are outstanding.

DATE: 12 September 2026 is in the past (today is 13 October 2026). Client or venue must confirm the intended date before any booking. 2027-09-11 is a placeholder: 12 September 2027 falls on a Sunday, not the Saturday the client specified, so the client should confirm whether 11 or 12 September 2027 is intended. Venue availability is unconfirmed for every candidate date.

VENUE: Availability for the chapel ceremony at 16:00, olive grove cocktails from 17:15, dinner at 19:30 and last shuttle at 01:30 is unconfirmed. Venue must be told a dog (Pimienta, ring bearer) is attending. Venue must confirm it can supply or allow a microphone and sound in the chapel for the interpreter.
CEREMONY: Bilingual Spanish and Finnish. Interpreter Päivikki Järvenpää must never be cut from the budget.

CATERING: Strictly nut-free event with no nuts of any kind. Cake must contain no almonds or other nut ingredients. Caterer and cake supplier must confirm in writing that the kitchen and supply chain can guarantee this. One guest has a severe nut allergy and carries an EpiPen. Menu not yet supplied. Vegetarian (11) and children's (4) meal counts to be confirmed with caterer.
PHOTOGRAPHY: Do not book Lumière Fotografia under any circumstances (double-booked a relative's wedding last summer). Replacement photographer, availability and price options still to be sourced.
MUSIC: DJ must not play 'Macarena' under any circumstances. Written confirmation from DJ required, along with DJ availability and fees.
STATIONERY: Current RSVP count for Eero's family is unknown. Finnish menu cards are added only if more than 25 of his family have confirmed. Count must be checked before printing.
WEATHER: Forecast can only be checked close to the event date. If forecast exceeds 32°C, cocktails move from the olive grove to the wine cellar. Conditional item, not yet assessable.

BUDGET: Hard cap of EUR 42,000. Total is EUR 0 because no line-item quotes have been received. Cut order: fireworks first. Interpreter must never be cut. If the ceremony starts late, shorten cocktails, never the ceremony. Order for the remaining items (flowers, photo booth, late bar) has not been set by the client and needs their decision if quotes exceed the cap.
